expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.P===50 && S.N===1 && S.r===2 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: one speaker, P = 50 mW, r = 2,0 m (must run before any setup)
on load: I = 0,050 W / (4π · 4,0 m²) = 9,95e-4 W/m² (lesson-answers sim-load-I)
on load: L = 90,0 dB (lesson-answers sim-load-L)
on load: sphere area 4πr² = 50,3 m²

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===2 && R[0].min==='1' && R[0].max==='100' && R[0].step==='1' && R[1].min==='1' && R[1].max==='20' && R[1].step==='0.5' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: two sliders: P 1–100 mW in steps of 1; r 1,0–20,0 m in steps of 0,5
two selects: number of speakers 1, 2, 4, 10 and speed hidas/normaali/nopea
DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='N,P,r' && P.P.unit==='mW' && P.r.unit==='m' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares P (mW), N and r (m)

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?720:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x720 (stacked, larger labels) under 500 px
the readout shows I in W/m² and L in dB
